data.long_description:
Loreto is an elegant low-rise development by DAMAC Properties, featuring modern glass-fronted apartments and townhouses. This striking complex offers a variety of residence options designed with contemporary finishes, combining functionality with stylish elegance. Each unit boasts generous living spaces, expansive windows, and private terraces, providing breathtaking panoramic views of the golf course or the iconic Dubai skyline.


  Key Features:


 Spacious Apartments: Enjoy generous living areas with large windows and terraces.
 Luxurious Townhouses: Experience upscale living with direct access to lush green spaces.
 Captivating Views: Marvel at scenic vistas of the golf course or Dubai’s skyline.
 Modern Interiors: Designed to enhance space, light, and comfort.


  Situated within the prestigious DAMAC Hills Estate, Loreto offers a vibrant community with top-tier amenities. Residents benefit from 400,000 square meters of verdant parkland, surrounding the renowned Trump International Golf Course. The gated community features world-class retail options, leisure facilities, parks, playgrounds, and outdoor gym sessions, providing a well-rounded living experience in a dynamic environment.
